integrity_note: All mathematical assertions are supported by the included analytical proof; numerical checker is auxiliary. Scientific review performed on this formulation only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Brownian motion with drift drawn once per attempt and held frozen. Not a proof for finite-persistence active Ornstein--Uhlenbeck trajectories. Does not establish uniqueness of an optimal reset rate or of an activity-induced sign-change threshold; resetting energetic costs are excluded. Literature-priority comparisons are qualified and not independently validated.
title: Rare frozen propulsion, exponential exit-time fluctuations, and a restart reversal
